# Synthetic media

`synthetic-a.webm` contains eight numbered solid-color images shown for one second each. `synthetic-b.webm` contains twelve differently colored numbered images shown for two seconds each. The image content was generated for this test; no personal media is used. `generate_video.py` uses Pillow's default font and an FFmpeg build with libvpx. Recreate with `python3 tests/fixtures/generate_video.py /path/to/ffmpeg a` and the same command with `b` (Pillow required). The generated test data may be reused with this repository. Pillow and FFmpeg are separate dependencies governed by their own licenses.
